title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Recurring Automatic Transfers from Checking
content:
An automatic transfer is a standing monthly instruction that moves a fixed sum from one of the customer's Piedmont Crescent Bank checking accounts into a Savings & Money Market Accounts product. This page covers who gives the instruction, what it must satisfy, how each monthly run behaves and how it is stopped.

## Rule

**Whose instruction.** Setting up or altering an automatic transfer is the owner's own decision about moving their own money.

**Funding account.** The checking account the money comes from must be owned by the same customer as the savings account and must be active at the moment the instruction is recorded; the bank's checking records for that account are the evidence.

**Amount.** The monthly sum may not be smaller than the minimum automatic transfer amount of the savings account's tier.

**Day.** The owner picks a day of the month between 1 and 28. In a month where that date is a non-business day, the money moves on the following business day instead.

**Each monthly run.** On the transfer day the sum posts to savings as an automatic transfer deposit and, in the same movement, is taken from the funding checking account. If taking it would leave the checking ledger balance below zero, that month's transfer simply does not happen: nothing posts and no fee arises. An automatic transfer never overdraws checking.

**Stopping.** Ending the instruction sets the monthly sum to 0.00 and removes the day and the funding account; it takes effect from the next run that would have been due.

## Minimum monthly amount by tier

| Tier | Lowest monthly amount accepted for an automatic transfer (USD) |
|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 25.00 |
| Statement Savings | 25.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 25.00 |
| Money Market Account | 100.00 |
| Premier Money Market | 100.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | 100.00 |

## Checklist for recording an instruction

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Funding checking account | same owner as the savings account, active when recorded |
| Monthly amount | at least the tier minimum above |
| Transfer day | a whole number from 1 to 28 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Premier Money Market owner asks for 75.00 a month. That is under the tier's 100.00 minimum, so it cannot be recorded at that amount.
- A Starter Savings owner picks the 15th; the 15th of some month falls on a Saturday. That month's transfer runs on the following Monday, or later if Monday is not a business day.
- The funding checking account holds 40.00 on the day a 50.00 transfer is due. The month is skipped with no posting and no charge.
